title: Small correctness fixes from the step 2 reviews
description:
- `get_item_changes(since_revision=N)` skips WORK_STATE_UPDATED entries recorded at revision N (work-state entries keep the current revision); compare by entry ID or document it in the proto.
- Duplicate `update_mask` paths are accepted and recorded twice in `changed_fields`.
- A malformed or empty rank on disk surfaces as INVALID_ARGUMENT to a caller who sent no rank.
- `context.Canceled` / `DeadlineExceeded` map to INTERNAL in `service.ErrorCode`.
- The localhost Host check is case-sensitive and rejects a trailing dot (`localhost.`).
- Re-claiming your own task doesn't refresh its feature affinity.
